text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, haah, haah-- Taaaahhhhhh...!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"UNUOOOOOOOOOOHHH!!! BAKUSHIN BAKUSHIN 
BAKUSHIIIIIIIN!!"

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Hah... Hah... *pant*...!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: B-Baku... baku... ba-kuuuughh!!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Zephyr-san... you're like—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: So fast...!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: ...I suppose I must say it, then.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: "You truly were— the 'Wind' itself!!"

text_block_list.name: Zephyr's Fans
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOOOOOH!! Zephyr! Zephyr! Zephyr! 
Zephyr!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much for your cheers.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
(I've gained the strength to conquer the 
mile. I've gained the speed to conquer the 
sprint.)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (To become the true wind—)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (Just one more...!)

Yamanin Zephyr returned to the underground 
tunnel after her magnificent victory.

Her expression was filled with radiant 
joy, and—

And she was filled with a fierce, burning 
resolve riding on this final, grand 
showdown.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Trainer. ...The time has finally come.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Let us go. To the final stage... the path 
of wind that even surpasses the "Emperor 
of the Mile".

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: —Off to the Tenno Sho (Autumn)!

That night. Returning to my room, I gave 
it some more thought.

Conquering the Yasuda Kinen, then the 
Sprinters Stakes... and on to the Tenno 
Sho (Autumn)...

Yamanin Zephyr has overcome the barrier of 
distance and is now attempting a feat not 
even the "Emperor of the Mile" could 
achieve. In that case—
choice_data_list: Isn't there more I can do...!
Isn't there something more I can do...!

text_block_list.text:
I need to think about this much more. I 
clench my fists tightly.

And then—the events from before summer 
suddenly crossed my mind.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. I've learned what it means to 
become the wind, sweeping up the fans, my 
fellow racers, and everyone around me.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
That is precisely why, during this summer, 
I will push even further.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"I wish to bathe thoroughly in those 
explosive winds, those flower-scented 
gales, swallow it all whole, and make it 
my strength."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Please. So that I may become a true, even 
fiercer tempest.

Yamanin Zephyr once said that being 
influenced by strong rivals running 
alongside her made her grow even stronger.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Hello, Trainer-san. Today as well—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Oh, my...?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Hello, Zephyr-san. I look forward to 
working with you today.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Hey hey~. Well, please go easy on me.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Turbo's body is totally warmed up now! 
Let's start already, hurry, hurry!!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Um, R-Rice is ready whenever, too...!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Everyone...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"...Aren't those the ones scheduled to run 
in the Tenno Sho (Autumn)?"

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Could it be that Trainer...?
choice_data_list:
I asked if we could do a joint training 
session.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well, it seemed like there'd be plenty in 
it for us too, so it was a generous offer 
and all, but...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, getting this whole lineup 
together! I almost freaked out when I got 
to the track."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well, still, come to think of it, you were 
totally exhausted when you came to us, 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Truth be told, weren't you running around 
quite a bit? Ah, to be young and full of 
life.
choice_data_list:
I-'d appreciate it if you could keep that 
quiet...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: My... ...Hehe, hehehehe.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Ah, what a pity. I would have loved to see 
you dashing around like a sudden gust of 
wind, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...Regardless, Trainer. My respect and 
gratitude go to your unwavering, gentle 
breeze.

And so, together with Yamanin Zephyr, we 
began our final push toward the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn)...!
